README.md.rationale: Add a separately bounded operator reproducer for a complete legal native mirror, ordinary round-four screen-labelled versus preservation paths, actual B response, read-only range/visibility/charge-target audits and exact persistence/replay. No production algorithm or existing measured workload is changed.
README.md.source_obligation: Retain all 78 models, actual source-backed equipment, original seed and deployment; preserve full PathWitness paths and rejected attempts through ordinary decisions. Distinguish native target eligibility from an accepted charge path or combat outcome.
README.md.unchanged_work: The engine, source catalog, RNG, geometry solvers, serializers and replay authority are unchanged. Existing six-case native serial owner and source closure, all case/shard inventories, scheduling evidence, 67% full-package branch floor, twelve shards, 120-second mirror, 180-second smoke, 600-second quality and 1620/strictly-over-1800 covered limits remain unchanged. The new uncollected operator helpers have no historical benchmark family and assert no speedup, useful screen or full-game certification.
